controls.label: Shape
controls.title: Original radar reconstruction archived by NASA/JPL, at its published kilometer scale. The shared grid marks unavailable imagery. This is source geometry, not a photographic surface or reflectance map. The published model has uneven latitude coverage, including an unseen region near the north pole. Its small depressions and rounded outline are radar-derived geometry; no measured optical surface texture is supplied. Lighting uses the selected pole and an arbitrary display phase.
controls.summary: Shape from radar observations. The gray grid marks missing optical imagery; lighting shows the model.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.title: Color shows original model radius minus a 0.2075 km reference sphere. It includes global shape and is not height above a gravitational equipotential. This is a derived view of the same radar reconstruction, not an independent topographic measurement. Display resolution adds no observational detail.
controls.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
